title: Tokens and cost for a RAG assistant
scenario: Estimate token throughput and cost for an internal question-answering assistant. All prices are illustrative assumptions. Anything within 25% counts.
solution:
1. **Peak questions:** 200,000 ÷ (8 × 3,600 s) ≈ 6.9 per second during working hours, × 3 ≈ **21 per second**.
2. **Peak output tokens:** 20.8 × 300 ≈ **6,250 tokens per second** (and 20.8 × 2,500 ≈ 52,000 input tokens per second).
3. **Cost per 1,000 questions:** input 2,500 × $3 ÷ 1,000,000 = $0.0075; output 300 × $15 ÷ 1,000,000 = $0.0045; total $0.012 per question = **$12 per 1,000**.
4. **Daily cost:** 200,000 × $0.012 = **$2,400 per working day**. Input tokens are 62% of the cost, so retrieving fewer, better passages is the main cost lever.
